W.note: Three distinct beziers with long 1-2s blurred aura, drifting halo and arrow reveal on a dark cohesive page, with focus ring and reduced-motion handled; slightly heavy with animated blur layers.

X.note: Glassy button with lingering pre-blurred glow (opacity/transform only) and good focus and reduced-motion, but the fast 190ms face response makes the effect read as a glow-up more than ethereal.

Y.note: Technically careful (pre-blurred glow, settle bezier, fine-pointer gating) but the subtle blue glow on a flat lavender page is modest and the secondary buttons look cluttered.

Z.note: Pastel gradient wash with overshoot and spinning aura feels airy and the full-width button is clear on phone, but the label washes out mid-hover and transition:all plus a light page are less disciplined.
